literal_meaning: সাতটি ঘাটের একচোখা কড়ি (seven riverbanks' one-eyed cowrie shell)
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই ঘটনাটা তো সাতঘাটের কানা কড়ি, সবাই জানে।
তার নামটা সাতঘাটের কানা কড়ির মতো পরিচিত।
example_sentences_in_english: This fact is common knowledge; everyone knows it.
His name is as well-known as common knowledge.
history: The idiom draws from ancient Bengali trade practices where cowrie shells (কড়ি) were used as currency, and a 'one-eyed' shell from multiple ghats (river markets) symbolized something universally recognized and valued across regions.
note: Refers to the ubiquity of cowrie shells in rural Bengali economy.
